The '''Battle of Barseg''' was fought between the [[Kingdom of Cron]] of [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] and the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barseg]].

Following the [[Battle of Chandaar|defeat]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]], Xer installed himself as the new [[King of Cron]] and launched a campaign to take control of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. After have conquered the complete Kingdom of Cron, Xer attacked a trio of allied kingdoms on his rimward flank: [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]], [[Cadinth]] and Barseg. After those victories, the Three Allied Kingdoms were integrated into the [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
